blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The entry doors after 12th humanities, and when they close

rows: CLAT UG (5-year integrated law at National Law Universities)
Applications 3 Aug to 31 Oct 2026; exam Sunday 6 Dec 2026, 2 pm to 4 pm (Consortium press release, 22 July 2026). Recent cycles were pen-and-paper with 120 questions.
Any stream, so humanities students can apply. Recent cycles asked 45% in Class 12 (40% SC/ST); the Consortium's admission notice sets the 2027 rule.
NID DAT (B.Des at the National Institute of Design)
Registration 10 Sep to 30 Nov 2026; prelims 20 Dec 2026
Class 12 in any stream, including humanities.
NDA (National Defence Academy, Army wing)
UPSC's 2027 exam calendar lists the notice on 2 Dec 2026, applications until 22 Dec 2026 and the written exam on 11 Apr 2027

Army wing takes any Class 12 stream. Air Force and Navy need Physics, Chemistry and Maths. Coaching sources for this cycle quote a birth window of 2 July 2008 to 1 July 2011; the UPSC notice is the final word.
NIFT (B.Des and B.FTech)
Stage 1 on 10 Jan 2027; NTA opens the form
B.Des takes Class 12 in any stream, with no minimum percentage. Age under 24 on 1 August 2027 (five years more for SC/ST/PwD). B.FTech needs Physics and Maths, so it is not a humanities door.
UCEED (B.Des at IITs and IIITDM Jabalpur)
Registration from 1 Oct 2026 and exam on 17 Jan 2027, as reported for this cycle; uceed.iitb.ac.in has the final dates
Any stream. Recent rules: born on or after 1 October 2001 (five years more for SC/ST/PwD) and at most two attempts in consecutive years.
IPMAT (5-year Integrated Programme in Management, IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak)
IIM Indore held its 2026 test on 4 May 2026 (2 hours); expect the 2027 cycle at a similar time
Any stream. IIM Rohtak asks 60% in Class 10 and 12 (55% SC/ST/PwD). Coaching sites disagree on whether IIM Indore still sets a percentage, so read its notice. Both have an age cap of about 20.
CLAT UG (5-year integrated law at National Law Universities)
The window closing soonest. In 2026, 72,631 candidates appeared; the 2027 intake is about 3,693 regular seats across the NLUs.
NID DAT (B.Des at the National Institute of Design)
A portfolio-and-drawing skill test, not a marks test.
NDA (National Defence Academy, Army wing)
The written exam has a 300-mark Maths paper, so humanities students need a real Maths plan.
NIFT (B.Des and B.FTech)
General Ability Test (includes a quantitative section) plus Creative Ability Test, then a second-stage situation test or interview. Registration is expected in November to December 2026.
UCEED (B.Des at IITs and IIITDM Jabalpur)
An IIT-linked design route with its own entrance exam. IITs Bombay, Delhi, Guwahati, Hyderabad and Roorkee plus IIITDM Jabalpur use the score.
IPMAT (5-year Integrated Programme in Management, IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak)
Quantitative Ability and Verbal Ability. A humanities student must be comfortable with school-level maths.

blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The maths Maths Requirement Many Humanities Students Discover Too Late

rows: DU BA (Hons) Economics
Mathematics or Applied Mathematics is compulsory in the CUET combination.
Choose Political Science, History, Sociology or Psychology Honours if maths stopped in Class 10, or read each other university's own Economics rule before ruling the subject out.
NDA written exam
300 of the 900 written-exam marks are Mathematics. The Army wing is open to humanities, but the paper is not optional.
Decide early. Practise Class 11 to 12 maths steadily, or choose another uniformed route such as CDS after graduation.
IPMAT

Quantitative Ability is a large share of a 2-hour paper, and IIM Indore's version includes short-answer questions that reward speed. The IPM AT 2026 score was also accepted by 12 partner institutions, so a decent score has more than one use.
Try a full mock paper first. A big gap now means either a serious maths plan or a different management route after a BA.
CLAT
Quantitative Techniques is only about 10% of the paper and stays at school level.
This is one of the few competitive exams here where a maths-shy humanities student is not penalised heavily.

blocks.heading: Age Steps a Drop Year Can Close
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: The age steps a drop year can close

rows: NDA (Army wing)
A birth window of roughly 2 July 2008 to 1 July 2011 in the coaching notices for the 2027 written exam; the UPSC notice fixes it each cycle.
Closes early. The exam is aimed at students straight out of Class 12, so a drop year can take you past the window.
IPM at IIM Indore and IIM Rohtak
IIM Indore has asked for a birth date on or after 1 August 2007 (SC/ST/PwD five years earlier); IIM Rohtak asks for a maximum age of about 20.
Closes early. One repeat attempt after a drop year may still fit, a second usually does not, so check the exact date first.
UCEED
Born on or after 1 October 2001 in the recent rule, and at most two attempts in consecutive years.
Gives a second try, not a third. Plan the portfolio and the sketching practice so the first attempt counts.
NIFT B.Des
Under 24 on 1 August of the admission year (five years more for SC/ST/PwD).
Stays open for several years after Class 12, so it suits a student who needs time to build a portfolio.
CLAT and the Bar Council cap

CLAT has no upper age limit, but the Bar Council of India's resolution caps admission to the 5-year LLB at 20 years (22 for SC/ST/OBC). On 25 September 2026 the Supreme Court asked the Bar Council whether it will withdraw that cap and listed the matter again in about two weeks.
Unsettled. A student planning a late attempt should check the outcome and the law school's own admission notice before paying any fee.
NCET (ITEP), NCHM JEE, CUET UG
No upper age limit for NCET or NCHM JEE. CUET UG asks only for Class 12 pass.
The open doors. If a drop year is likely, these keep a fallback alive.

The Exception. Maths Is Compulsory.
BA (Hons) Political Science, History, Psychology
One language plus three domain subjects; History, Political Science, Sociology, Psychology and Geography all count as humanities domains.
Maths is not asked. Study the subjects you actually took in Class 12, because DU says you must appear in the subjects you studied.
BA (Hons) English
English from the language list plus two or three domain subjects.
A strong reading habit matters more than any single domain subject here.
Programmes with extra tests
DU Fine Arts and Music or Physical Education add a practical or performance test alongside CUET.
Read each programme line in the DU bulletin, not just the department name.

Law: top NLU
NLSIU BA LLB 2026 batch reported a median of Rs 21 lakh a year and a high of Rs 65 lakh. NIRF data shows a median of Rs 16 lakh for 2023-24 and Rs 19 lakh for 2024-25.
Tier-1 firm first-year offers are reported at up to Rs 22.5 lakh a year, but such roles are limited to roughly 200 to 300 fresh associates a year, mostly from the top 5 to 8 NLUs.
Design: NIFT and similar
No clean published median for B.Des graduates. Compilations for NIFT Mumbai show packages from about Rs 2.5 lakh to Rs 12 or 13 lakh, with placement of about 70 to 79% for design courses.
Students report starting offers of roughly Rs 4 to 5 lakh, with wide spread by campus.
Teaching: government school

Basic pay in central-government school levels under the 7th Pay Commission is Rs 35,400 for a primary teacher, Rs 44,900 for a trained graduate teacher and Rs 47,600 for a post-graduate teacher, before allowances. State schools set their own scales.
Steady, with regular pay scale increments.
Media, content, BA jobs
No reliable public median exists, so treat any single figure with suspicion.
Compare with the average regular salaried wage in India: about Rs 24,217 a month for men and Rs 18,353 for women in 2025 (PLFS), roughly Rs 2.9 lakh and Rs 2.2 lakh a year.
Law: top NLU
A top-college outcome, not the typical one. A district-court junior may get as low as Rs 300 per appearance with no fixed monthly pay, and paralegal roles report Rs 2 to 3.5 lakh.
Design: NIFT and similar
These are secondary compilations and student reports, not audited figures. Ask NIFT or NID for the placement report of the specific campus and batch.
Media, content, BA jobs
Pay moves with proof of work, a niche and the employer type more than with the degree label.

blocks.heading: Highest Paying Jobs for Humanities Students
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Highest paying jobs for humanities students: the short list with a growth rating

rows: UX writer, content designer, content strategist
A portfolio of real product copy, basic research skill and comfort with design tools.
Scalable. Freelance projects and retainers can grow without trading hours one for one.
Corporate communications, PR, brand storytelling
A niche (finance, health, tech) and measurable campaign results you can show.
Scalable with a business layer. Agency roles are crowded; a boutique service or personal-brand consulting is the layer.
HR, talent acquisition, learning and development
HR analytics, hiring-process ownership and the ability to design training people actually finish.
Scalable with a business layer. A salaried ladder first; recruitment or training consulting on top.
Psychology and counselling
A recognised postgraduate qualification, a niche and the trust to hold your own clients.
Scalable with a business layer. A bachelor's alone has a low ceiling; a practice or workshops raise it.
Media, video and audience-led work
An audience or a body of work you own, not the employer's name.
Scalable. Income can grow with reach, though few people reach the top.
Law, policy research, civil services, government teaching
Beating rivals at stage after stage, then a separate climb after entry.
Not so scalable. Strong pay at the very top, but growth is capped by seats or pay bands. Keep a second route and a skill that can grow on its own.

blocks.heading: What Shrinks and What Holds
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: AI and humanities careers: what shrinks and what holds

rows: Law
First-pass research, summaries and standard drafts are already speeded up by AI tools.
Judgment, negotiation, spotting risk, client trust and taking responsibility for the final draft.
Media and content
Routine explainers and rewrites are commoditised fastest.
Original reporting, a real point of view, domain depth and audience trust.
Design
Template layouts and quick mock-ups are easy to generate.
Taste, brief understanding, client conversations and finishing a project end to end.
Psychology and teaching
Content delivery and worksheets can be automated.
Human relationship, ethics, supervision and live judgment with a real person.

blocks.heading: Myths That Cost Families a Year
blocks.sourceSectionTitle: Myths that cost families a year

rows: "Humanities has no scope."
It opens law, design, management, teaching, defence, psychology, media and public policy. What is scarce is proof of skill, not scope.
"CLAT is a Bar Council exam held in January."
CLAT is run by the Consortium of NLUs. The 2027 admission test is on 6 December 2026.
"Delhi University takes UG students through DUET."
DU undergraduate admission runs through CUET UG scores and its common seat allocation process.
"Arts students cannot join the armed forces after 12th."
The Army wing of NDA takes any stream. Only the Air Force and Navy wings need Physics, Chemistry and Maths, and the Maths paper applies to everyone.
"Arts and humanities are different streams."
In Indian school boards they describe the same Class 11 to 12 stream. Course names differ by university, not the stream.
"Any big salary range online is what I will earn."
Pay depends on the college, the year, the role and your proof. Ask for a median with a denominator.
